title: Second brain set-up
intro: These answers decide how your second brain is built. The areas become folders of notes. Your answers go into second-brain/INDEX.md and DECISIONS.md.

questions.text: Whose thinking goes in the second brain?
Which areas does your thinking fall into?
questions.help: Pick 5 to 10. Each one becomes a folder of notes. The AI suggested these from your agency process.
To use them, put the files or an export in second-brain/inbox/ in this repo. Never give a password.
